subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: While the switch-over is in effect, the system shall apply automated document-pipeline checks only to existing documents in repositories where those checks remain enabled, and shall apply none to draft-born contract parts. In the Pyxis source repository it shall preserve the approved memory-migration bypass; selecting local-git shall not restore legacy document checks.
rationale: Frozen-document authoring rules survive independently of the operator-disabled source gate
fit_criterion: Enabled document-pipeline fixtures retain existing-document immutability refusals and produce zero such findings for draft-born parts. A trusted Pyxis-source fixture continues to bypass legacy document checks at push and CI in both hosted and local mode; retained non-document checks still run. Inspection confirms that source authoring rules for frozen documents remain binding.
